notes.title: Bugfix Update for v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Once again, thanks for your support and feedback! Here's a summary of what has changed:

Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where the panic button could trigger even if a grocery or ID was physically obscuring it. You can still press it during grocery inspection if you rotate the item so it doesn't cover the button!
 End-of-day report no longer tries to predict your future when advancing to the next day

Tweaks

 Year has been added for clarification, and in-game dates have been shifted to account for that
 Minor improvements to performance

notes.title: Bugfix Update for v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you for finding and reporting bugs! The game has been updated to address these issues, so you can check it out.

Bugfixes

 Fixed an issue where characters would overlap sometimes
 The invisible robber causing the glitchy "try again" has been detained for life

Tweaks

 Items are now easier to place into the basket
